upstreamFrontmatter.name: media-use
upstreamFrontmatter.description: Agent Media OS — resolve any media need (BGM, SFX, image, icon) into a frozen local file + ledger record. One verb (`resolve`) handles the full cascade — project cache, global cache, HeyGen catalog search, freeze, register. Keeps search noise on disk, hands the agent a path. Use when a composition needs background music, sound effects, images, or icons.
